fusions.name: Scent Trail
fusions.desc: A snapping bite that deals 9 damage and heals you for 20% of it. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Final Pass
fusions.desc: Can only be used on a target at or below 30% health. It deals 22 damage and heals you for 30% of it.

fusions.name: Smell of Blood
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing Circles
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5 they all spend at once: you heal for 4% of your maximum health per stack (20% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 8 seconds.
